g.text: MEA CO2 CAPTURE OTS VER 1 · CHEM ENG CHULALONGKORN UNIVERSITY
MEA CO2 CAPTURE UNIT — ABSORBER T-101 / STRIPPER T-102
Capture 90.0 % · CO2 product 12.7 t/h (wet) · SRD 3.94 GJ/t
1. Rev 0 — issued for teaching. Flows t/h; temperatures °C; pressures kPa a.
2. Flag numbers come from the OTS simulator model at its design point (noise off). Training values, not a vendor
3. Flags only on streams the model calculates. Utilities: cw 30 °C, lps 3.5 bar a (assumed, TBC).
4. Tags as P&ID CC-PID-101. Only the process-defining control valves are shown. Sizes indicative.
